title: Car rental website
description: React-based frontend application for car rental services. It features car listings with filtering, detailed car views, a booking system.

title: Intranet Company Application
description: comprehensive solution for internal organizational management, offering a wide range of features to enhance communication, collaboration, and resource sharing within a company. Built on a robust and scalable framework, it ensures security, efficiency, and ease of use for all users.

title: Bakery service website
description: modern React-based web application focused on showcasing and promoting various types of croissants. The application serves as a digital platform for a bakery or café, featuring an attractive and user-friendly interface. It includes multiple pages for different sections of the business.

title: Mathew Game
description: mathew-game (graduation project), a mathematical game Designed specifically for school students, Mathew is an engaging and interactive educational game that makes learning math fun and exciting. In Mathew, players embark on a quest filled with challenging math puzzles, exciting challenges.
